# Build and install on Arch Linux:  makepkg -si   (run in this folder)
pkgname=autohotkey-ux
pkgver=2.0.19
pkgrel=1
pkgdesc="AutoHotkey Dash, New Script, Launch/Editor settings and Window Spy for KDE Plasma"
arch=('x86_64')
license=('GPL-2.0-or-later')
depends=('gcc-libs' 'glibc' 'libxkbcommon' 'wayland' 'libx11' 'libglvnd' 'xdg-utils' 'xdg-desktop-portal')
optdepends=(
  'wine: run AutoHotkey scripts and Ahk2Exe'
  'kdotool: Window Spy on KDE Plasma (Wayland)'
  'xdotool: Window Spy on X11'
  'xorg-xprop: window class in Window Spy on X11'
  'imagemagick: pixel colour in Window Spy on X11'
  'kdialog: launcher error messages'
  'noto-fonts: the intended UI font'
)
makedepends=('cargo')
source=()

build() {
  cd "$startdir"
  cargo build --release --locked
}

package() {
  cd "$startdir"
  install -Dm755 target/release/autohotkey-ux "$pkgdir/usr/bin/autohotkey-ux"
  install -Dm644 packaging/autohotkey-ux-dash.desktop "$pkgdir/usr/share/applications/autohotkey-ux-dash.desktop"
  install -Dm644 packaging/autohotkey-ux-spy.desktop "$pkgdir/usr/share/applications/autohotkey-ux-spy.desktop"
  install -Dm644 packaging/autohotkey.xml "$pkgdir/usr/share/mime/packages/autohotkey-ux.xml"
  install -Dm644 packaging/autohotkey-new.desktop "$pkgdir/usr/share/templates/autohotkey-new.desktop"
  install -Dm644 packaging/template.ahk "$pkgdir/usr/share/templates/.source/AutoHotkey Script.ahk"
}

# AutoHotkey Dash for Linux (Rust)

A Rust/egui rebuild of AutoHotkey's UX tools (the Dash, New Script, Launch
settings, Editor settings, Window Spy and the version launcher), made for Arch
Linux with KDE Plasma. AutoHotkey itself is a Windows program, so scripts and
Ahk2Exe run through **Wine**.

## Install on Arch

```sh
sudo pacman -S --needed base-devel rust wine
makepkg -si            # in this folder
```

Optional: `kdotool` (AUR, Window Spy on Wayland), `xdotool xorg-xprop imagemagick`
(Window Spy on X11), `kdialog`.

Put an AutoHotkey install where the app can find it (any of):
`~/.local/share/AutoHotkey`, `~/.wine/drive_c/Program Files/AutoHotkey`,
`/opt/autohotkey`, or set `AHK_ROOT=/path/to/AutoHotkey`. It should contain
`v2/AutoHotkey64.exe` (and optionally `v1.1.x/`, `Compiler/Ahk2Exe.exe`, `UX/installed-files.csv`).

## Use

| Command | What it opens |
|---|---|
| `autohotkey-ux` | the Dash |
| `autohotkey-ux --new [folder/or/file.ahk]` | New Script |
| `autohotkey-ux --launch-config` | Launch settings |
| `autohotkey-ux --editor` | Editor settings |
| `autohotkey-ux --spy` | Window Spy |
| `autohotkey-ux --run script.ahk [args]` | run a script with the right AutoHotkey version |
| `autohotkey-ux --edit script.ahk` | open a script in your chosen editor |
| `autohotkey-ux --install-desktop` | make .ahk files open with the launcher |

Settings live in `~/.config/autohotkey-ux/config.json` (the original used the
Windows registry under `HKCU\Software\AutoHotkey`).

params.resolution: Implemented with kdotool on KDE Wayland and xdotool/xprop/ImageMagick on X11 (title, class, process, pid, id, mouse and window positions; colour only on X11). Status bar / control text have no Linux equivalent and stay empty. Needs a test on a real Arch KDE machine; this Windows workspace can't run it.

Replaced by a simplified line-marker count (v1: legacy commands with commas, '=' assignment, ByRef, #NoEnv...; v2: '=>', function-call commands, #HotIf, '&' params...), same decision rule (pick only when one version's marks appear). A sample v1 script was identified as v1 and the installed v2 scripts resolve via #Requires. Not compared against the original on a large corpus — estimated.

params.text: Rust/egui rebuild in app/ (Dash, New Script, Launch Config, Editor select, Window Spy, launcher --run, version picker). Original windows pictured in app/shots/original-*.png; ours via `--screenshot f --window dash|new|launch|editor|spy`.
